sentences.text: The armor ornamentation resembles Holonema but features much coarser concentrically arranged ridges.
The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — was originally described by Kayser in 1880 as a species of Dinichthys.
The species was redescribed in 1964 by Obruchev as a holonematid.
The genus belongs to the parent group Holonematidae, is classified in the family Holonematidae, and is classified in the class Placodermi.
It lived during the Middle Devonian Givetian age in Gerolstein, Germany.
